fn_execute_budget_transition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ifms_budget.fn_execute_budget_transition(p_proposal_id bigint, p_action_code character varying, p_acted_by bigint, p_remarks text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_proposal ifms_budget.budget_proposal%ROWTYPE;
  v_transition ifms_budget.workflow_transition%ROWTYPE;
  v_is_authorized boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_proposal
  FROM ifms_budget.budget_proposal
  WHERE proposal_id = p_proposal_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Budget proposal ID % does not exist', p_proposal_id;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_transition
  FROM ifms_budget.workflow_transition
  WHERE workflow_id = v_proposal.workflow_id
    AND from_status_id = v_proposal.status_id
    AND action_code = upper(p_action_code)
    AND is_active
    AND (amount_from IS NULL OR v_proposal.total_amount >= amount_from)
    AND (amount_to IS NULL OR v_proposal.total_amount <= amount_to)
  ORDER BY transition_id
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Action % is not permitted for the present proposal status', p_action_code;
  END IF;

  IF v_transition.remarks_required
     AND NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_remarks, '')), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Remarks are mandatory for action %', p_action_code;
  END IF;

  IF v_transition.required_role_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ifms_budget.user_role ur
      WHERE ur.user_id = p_acted_by
        AND ur.role_id = v_transition.required_role_id
        AND ur.organization_id = v_proposal.organization_id
        AND ur.is_active
        AND ur.effective_from <= current_date
        AND (ur.effective_to IS NULL OR ur.effective_to >= current_date)
    ) INTO v_is_authorized;

    IF NOT v_is_authorized THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Application user ID % does not hold the required role for action %', p_acted_by, p_action_code;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  UPDATE ifms_budget.budget_proposal
  SET status_id = v_transition.to_status_id,
      submitted_at = CASE WHEN upper(p_action_code) IN ('SUBMIT', 'RESUBMIT') THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE submitted_at END,
      submitted_by = CASE WHEN upper(p_action_code) IN ('SUBMIT', 'RESUBMIT') THEN p_acted_by ELSE submitted_by END,
      approved_at = CASE WHEN upper(p_action_code) = 'APPROVE' THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE approved_at END,
      approved_by = CASE WHEN upper(p_action_code) = 'APPROVE' THEN p_acted_by ELSE approved_by END,
      updated_by = p_acted_by,
      updated_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE proposal_id = p_proposal_id;

  INSERT INTO ifms_budget.workflow_action_log
    (workflow_id, entity_type, entity_id, from_status_id, to_status_id,
     action_code, action_remarks, acted_by, created_by)
  VALUES
    (v_proposal.workflow_id, 'BUDGET_PROPOSAL', p_proposal_id,
     v_proposal.status_id, v_transition.to_status_id,
     upper(p_action_code), p_remarks, p_acted_by, p_acted_by);
END;
$function$

fn_get_budget_availability.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ifms_budget.fn_get_budget_availability(p_budget_version_id bigint, p_department_id bigint, p_demand_id bigint, p_ddo_id bigint, p_coa_id bigint, p_scheme_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_project_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_fund_source_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(provision_amount numeric, allocation_amount numeric, release_amount numeric, commitment_amount numeric, expenditure_amount numeric, available_amount numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(le.provision_amount),0)::numeric(18,2) AS provision_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(le.allocation_amount),0)::numeric(18,2) AS allocation_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(le.release_amount),0)::numeric(18,2) AS release_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(le.commitment_amount),0)::numeric(18,2) AS commitment_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(le.expenditure_amount),0)::numeric(18,2) AS expenditure_amount,
    (COALESCE(SUM(le.provision_amount),0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(le.commitment_amount),0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(le.expenditure_amount),0))::numeric(18,2) AS available_amount
  FROM ifms_budget.budget_ledger_entry le
  JOIN ifms_budget.budget_ledger_batch lb ON lb.ledger_batch_id = le.ledger_batch_id
  WHERE lb.batch_status = 'POSTED'
    AND le.entry_status = 'POSTED'
    AND le.budget_version_id = p_budget_version_id
    AND le.department_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_department_id
    AND le.demand_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_demand_id
    AND le.ddo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_ddo_id
    AND le.coa_id = p_coa_id
    AND le.scheme_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scheme_id
    AND le.project_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_project_id
    AND le.fund_source_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_fund_source_id;
$function$

fn_lock_budget_version.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ifms_budget.fn_lock_budget_version(p_budget_version_id bigint, p_user_id bigint, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE ifms_budget.budget_version
  SET is_locked = true,
      version_status = 'LOCKED',
      locked_at = clock_timestamp(),
      locked_by = p_user_id,
      lock_reason = p_reason,
      updated_by = p_user_id,
      updated_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE budget_version_id = p_budget_version_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Budget version % does not exist', p_budget_version_id;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

fn_post_budget_ledger.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ifms_budget.fn_post_budget_ledger(p_batch_no character varying, p_batch_date date, p_source_module character varying, p_event_type character varying, p_source_reference_no character varying, p_budget_version_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_department_id bigint, p_demand_id bigint, p_ddo_id bigint, p_coa_id bigint, p_scheme_id bigint, p_project_id bigint, p_fund_source_id bigint, p_provision_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_allocation_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_release_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_commitment_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_expenditure_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_receipt_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_narration text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_posted_by bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_batch_id bigint;
  v_entry_id bigint;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ifms_budget.budget_ledger_batch
    (batch_no, batch_date, source_module, event_type, source_reference_no, batch_status, narration, posted_at, posted_by, created_by)
  VALUES
    (p_batch_no, p_batch_date, p_source_module, p_event_type, p_source_reference_no, 'POSTED', p_narration, clock_timestamp(), p_posted_by, p_posted_by)
  ON CONFLICT (batch_no) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = clock_timestamp()
  RETURNING ledger_batch_id INTO v_batch_id;

  INSERT INTO ifms_budget.budget_ledger_entry
    (ledger_batch_id, posting_date, budget_version_id, organization_id, department_id, demand_id, ddo_id,
     coa_id, scheme_id, project_id, fund_source_id, provision_amount, allocation_amount, release_amount,
     commitment_amount, expenditure_amount, receipt_amount, narration, created_by)
  VALUES
    (v_batch_id, p_batch_date, p_budget_version_id, p_organization_id, p_department_id, p_demand_id, p_ddo_id,
     p_coa_id, p_scheme_id, p_project_id, p_fund_source_id, p_provision_amount, p_allocation_amount, p_release_amount,
     p_commitment_amount, p_expenditure_amount, p_receipt_amount, p_narration, p_posted_by)
  RETURNING ledger_entry_id INTO v_entry_id;

  RETURN v_entry_id;
END;
$function$

sp_rev_approve_booking_vouchers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE ifms_budget.sp_rev_approve_booking_vouchers(IN p_checker_id bigint, IN p_remarks text DEFAULT 'Verified and approved by PAO Checker.'::text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
        BEGIN
            UPDATE ifms_budget.account_voucher
            SET status = 'Approved',
                checker_user_id = p_checker_id,
                checker_remarks = COALESCE(p_remarks, 'Verified and bulk approved by PAO Checker.'),
                approved_at = clock_timestamp(),
                updated_by = p_checker_id
            WHERE status = 'Draft';

            UPDATE ifms_budget.rev_recon_result
            SET booking_status = 'BOOKED',
                updated_at = clock_timestamp(),
                updated_by = p_checker_id
            WHERE recon_id IN (
                SELECT recon_id FROM ifms_budget.account_voucher WHERE status = 'Approved' AND recon_id IS NOT NULL
            ) AND booking_status != 'BOOKED';
        END;
        $procedure$

sp_rev_approve_upload_batch.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE ifms_budget.sp_rev_approve_upload_batch(IN p_batch_id bigint, IN p_checker_user_id bigint, IN p_remarks text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
BEGIN
    UPDATE ifms_budget.rev_upload_batch
    SET status = 'APPROVED',
        checker_user_id = p_checker_user_id,
        checker_remarks = p_remarks,
        approved_at = clock_timestamp()
    WHERE batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL';

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Upload batch % not found or not in PENDING_APPROVAL status.', p_batch_id;
    END IF;
END;
$procedure$
